Macedonian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈdilɛr]

Noun

[edit]

дилер • (diler) m (feminine дилерка, relational adjective дилерски)

  1. (finance) dealer, broker
  2. drug dealer

Declension

[edit]
Declension of дилер
singular plural
indefinite дилер (diler) дилери (dileri)
definite unspecified дилерот (dilerot) дилерите (dilerite)
definite proximal дилеров (dilerov) дилериве (dilerive)
definite distal дилерон (dileron) дилерине (dilerine)
vocative дилеру (dileru) дилери (dileri)
count form — дилера (dilera)

Russian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from English dealer.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈdʲilʲɪr]
  • Audio:(file)

Noun

[edit]

ди́лер • (díler) m anim (genitive ди́лера, nominative plural ди́леры, genitive plural ди́леров, relational adjective ди́лерский)

  1. dealer (of automobiles, drugs, cards, etc.)
  2. (finance) dealer, broker

Tajik

Etymology 1

[edit]

Borrowed from Russian ди́лер (díler), from English dealer.

Noun

[edit]

дилер • (diler)

  1. dealer, drug dealer

Ukrainian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from English dealer.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈdɪɫer]
  • Audio:(file)

Noun

[edit]

ди́лер • (dýler) m pers (genitive ди́лера, nominative plural ди́лери, genitive plural ди́лерів, female equivalent ди́лерка, relational adjective ди́лерський)

  1. dealer (of automobiles, drugs, cards, etc.)
  2. (finance) dealer, broker
